title: humboltia corniculata
intro: Humboltia corniculata, commonly known as Humboldt's riddle, is a plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Humboldt's riddle are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which can help in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
